<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2004|month=01|day=27|content=

* The People's Republic of China announces an outbreak of the deadly H5N1 strain of [[avian influenza]] in the autonomous region of [[Guangxi]], becoming the 10th country in Asia to do so.<ref>[http://www.straitstimes.com.sg/latest/story/0,4390,232055,00.html ]{{dead link|date=December 2015}}</ref> There are suspected cases in [[Hunan]] and [[Hubei]] provinces.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www1.chinadaily.com.cn/en/doc/2004-01/27/content_301172.htm |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120206161207/http://www1.chinadaily.com.cn/en/doc/2004-01/27/content_301172.htm |archive-date=2012-02-06 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.iht.com/articles/126779.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050207100508/http://www.iht.com/articles/126779.html |archive-date=2005-02-07 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* British Prime Minister [[Tony Blair]] narrowly defeats a rebellion in his own party over the [[Higher Education Act 2004|Higher Education Bill]]&nbsp;– a highly controversial bill to reform [[higher education]] funding, including the introduction of increased and variable [[Tuition payments|tuition]] fees. It is approved in the [[British House of Commons|House of Commons]] by 316 votes to 311.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk_politics/3434329.stm|title=BBC NEWS - UK - Politics - Blair wins key top-up fees vote|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://education.guardian.co.uk/students/tuitionfees/story/0,12757,1132974,00.html|title=Victory, of sorts, for Blair|author=Michael White|work=the Guardian|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* [[U.S. presidential election, 2004]]: Senator [[John Kerry]] wins the [[New Hampshire primary]]. [[Howard Dean]] comes second.
* [[Academy Awards]]: nominations announced, leading films are ''[[The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King]]'' (11), ''[[Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World|Master and Commander]]'' (10), ''[[Seabiscuit (film)|Seabiscuit]]'' (7), ''[[Mystic River (film)|Mystic River]]'' (6), and ''[[Cold Mountain (film)|Cold Mountain]]'' (6).  [[Keisha Castle-Hughes]], at 13, becomes the youngest nominee ever for the [[Academy Award for Best Actress]]
* A new [[e-mail]] [[Computer worm|worm]], [[Novarg/Mydoom]], is spreading rapidly to thousands of machines running [[Microsoft Windows]]. It rapidly becomes the fastest-spreading e-mail worm to date.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.f-secure.com/v-descs/novarg.shtml|title=Worm: W32/Mydoom|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://vil.nai.com/vil/content/v_100983.htm|title=W32/Mydoom@MM|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090405131911/http://vil.nai.com/vil/content/v_100983.htm|archive-date=5 April 2009|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://securityresponse.symantec.com/avcenter/venc/data/w32.novarg.a@mm.html|title=W32.Mydoom.A@mm|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060715164805/http://securityresponse.symantec.com/avcenter/venc/data/w32.novarg.a@mm.html|archive-date=15 July 2006|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www3.ca.com/virusinfo/virus.aspx?ID=38102 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151211154105/http://www3.ca.com/virusinfo/virus.aspx?ID=38102 |archive-date=2015-12-11 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.trendmicro.com/vinfo/virusencyclo/default5.asp?VName=WORM_MIMAIL.R|title=Worm|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.zdnet.com.au/news/security/0,2000061744,39115847,00.htm|title=Latest Topics|work=ZDNet|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060208000420/http://www.zdnet.com.au/news/security/0,2000061744,39115847,00.htm|archive-date=8 February 2006|url-status=dead}}</ref>
